detailed_descriptions_html.en:
»Sometimes things must wither before new seeds can sprout«

Experience the story of the island »Meadowsong«. Once known for their thriving agriculture, the harvest of Meadowsong is haunted by a mysterious Withering destroying everything. Build new production chains with fruits, wine and livestock and help to solve the mystery of the witches' coven!

Six new building types, eleven new goods, two new plants and four new animal species are waiting for you!


Pagonia’s fields are infested by the mysterious »Withering«! Fertile grounds become useless, plants are dying, Rats and Wolves raid fields and villages and your infected people are too weak to work.

Find a remedy to cure infected animals and Pagonians, keep the Withering at bay and carefully plan your strategy to defeat the witch coven.



Discover unknown plants and boost your resistance with new buildings that expand your food production chains. Your loyal pets will guard fields and a new monumental building called »Cornucopia« will provide useful abilities in exchange for sacrificial offerings. The island's inhabitants will support you with their knowledge and goods.

Key Features:

  • New buildings and production chains including fruit cultivation, animal husbandry, beverage production and the wonders of the mysterious Cornucopia
  • The new scenario island "Meadowsong" expands the exciting story of Pagonia and introduces a new challenge: "The Withering"
  • Thwart the plans and prevent the rituals of the powerful "Witches' Coven" – each witch possesses a unique ability
  • The new challenge "The Withering" and the "Witches' Coven" can also be played on procedurally generated maps

New Buildings:

  • Winery
  • Fruit Farm
  • Animal Farm
  • Cornucopia
  • Dog House
  • Cat Tree

New Goods:

  • Grapes
  • Apples

  • Wine
  • Apple Pie
  • Raisin Cake
  • Apple Juice
  • Healing Berries
  • Toadstools

New Plants:

  • Apple Trees
  • Grapevines

New Animals:

  • Pigs
  • Chicken
  • Guard Dogs
  • Cats

New Enemies / Enemy Base:

  • Witches
  • Withered Hideout
  • Witherwolves
  • Witherrats
